body:
The I power series divides by Gamma(1+nu), which has a pole at negative integer orders. For example, I_-1(2) returns 0 instead of 1.5906368546373291.

Apply I_-n = I_n before selecting the evaluation method. This covers the real, complex and exponentially weighted overloads without changing the selection rule.

testModifiedBesselFunctionsNegativeIntegerOrder checks four real reference values and complex reflection, including weighted functions. I ran this on Ubuntu 24.04 (g++ 13.3.0, Boost 1.83.0, C++17): the tests alone fail 16 assertions on 84fbf0a0e; with this patch, all 10 FunctionsTests cases pass. References use mpmath 1.3.0 at 50 digits.
